Foreign Affair is the seventh solo studio album by Tina Turner, released on September 18, 1989, through Capitol Records.
It was Turner's third album release after her massively successful comeback five years earlier with Private Dancer and her third and last album with the label.
Although the album was not a major success in Turner's native United States, it was a huge international hit, especially in Europe.
